_comment: Reviewed OSV advisories against the vcpkg ports (tools/ci/osv_scan.py). Each entry says why Interi is not exposed. Remove an entry when the port moves past the advisory; the scan notes waivers that match nothing.

waivers.reason: Sparse-index heap overflow write in cgltf_accessor_unpack_floats. The importer loads buffers before cgltf_validate (which bounds sparse indices by the accessor count) and asset_import's UnpackFloats refuses accessors whose component count differs from the output it sized (GltfImport.SparseAccessorOfAnotherType_IsCorrupt).

Sparse values read with the base view's byteStride in cgltf_accessor_unpack_floats. asset_import's UnpackFloats refuses sparse accessors whose stride differs from their element size (GltfImport.SparseAccessorWithAByteStride_IsCorrupt); cgltf_accessor_read_float returns 0 for sparse accessors.

Out-of-bounds read in the WAV BEXT metadata parser. engine/audio decodes through ma_decoder, whose WAV backend calls ma_dr_wav_init without MA_DR_WAV_WITH_METADATA, so metadata chunks are never parsed. Fixed upstream after 0.11.25 (1df46ae); drop this waiver when the vcpkg baseline moves past it.
Integer overflow in stb_hexwave.h hexwave_init. Interi compiles only stb_image.h (engine/asset_import/src/StbImplementation.cpp); stb_hexwave is never included.
Stack overflow in experimental/tinyobj_loader_opt.h. Interi uses tiny_obj_loader.h only; the experimental optimized loader is never included.
